newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce seeks 100 mln stg UK aid - report.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce seeks 100 mln stg UK aid - report.

text.p: Britain's Rolls-Royce Plc is seeking up to 100 million pounds in government aid to develop versions of its Trent engine, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
A spokesman for the company declined to comment.
The Sunday Times said the government aid could be used to help fund a programme of expansion.
The Trent 800 is the biggest version of the engine and has airline customers including Malaysia Airline System and Singapore Airlines.
Rolls-Royce won a $500 million order for Trent 700 engines from Emirates airline in January, adding to a previous order for Trent 800 engines for seven of its Boeing Co 777 aircraft.
"We are well-positioned on the Trent and there are a number of opportunities...we have a lot of strength in the market with Trent," the Rolls-Royce spokesman said.
